expectations.text: States that Guile has no linter and no clj-kondo equivalent exists.
expectations.evidence: Conveys the same substance: the repo's own Makefile target IS guild compile -W3, no separate linter tool used or implied.

expectations.text: Closest check run as guild3 compile -W 3 (or gmake lint) with a real output path.
expectations.evidence: Ran gmake lint, which invokes guild3 compile -W 3 -o .logs/lint.go.

expectations.text: Reports the warning text guild3 actually emitted, or states plainly it emitted none.
expectations.evidence: States clean output twice (with cache wiped to double-check).

expectations.text: Does not name/invent a linting tool that was not actually run.
expectations.evidence: Only ran what the Makefile's lint target runs.
